object.content: I've tried out so many frameworks to create an updated mobile web app for my electric imp powered relay. I ran across https://developers.google.com/web/fundamentals/ today and I think it may be best for what I want to do. Everything else I used so far has used complicated JavaScript to emulate a native iOS app. This framework seems like it uses a simple responsive theme. I only have a basic UI so far, but I like how there's a desktop layout (something nothing else has) and how everything instantly refreshes on all devices when code is changed. I still have to finish implementing the background JavaScript to actually make it communicate with the electric imp, but I am hopeful that I can do that without many problems.
